title: Token-bucketed latency SLIs + synthetic shadow harness and cross-region failover playbook
creator: Asha Menon
description: Goal: Create fine-grained token-bucketed SLIs (p50/p95/p99/p99.9) with heatmap rollups and a synthetic shadow harness that exercises admission/circuit policies across regions. Deliverables: 1) Metric instrumentation and name conventions; 2) Synthetic shadow workload runner that can replay sampled traffic to any region with adjustable KV cache/noise; 3) Grafana dashboards with tiled heatmaps, backpressure timelines, and admission decision traces; 4) Cross-region failover playbook and automated runbook snippets for on-call; 5) Acceptance tests that assert SLI derivations and shed behavior under controlled overload. Rationale: Existing token-level telemetry is coarse — we need bucketed rollups to detect emerging tail skew and region-specific degradation earlier than per-request p99. This work enables targeted rollouts (canary traffic shaping) and safer autoscale thresholds. Important constraints: instrumentation must keep cardinality low (prefix bucketing and histogram aggregates), avoid adding latency to hot paths, and be compatible with both hosted and dedicated runtime builds.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Emit 'token.latency.bucket.<prefix>' histograms with consistent tags: region, shard, admission_path, model_variant; 2) Dashboard shows 7-day comparison heatmap and p99.9 alerts; 3) Synthetic harness can run a 10k reqs/min shadow replay to any region and toggle KV-cache hit rate and token-noise; 4) Runbook includes steps to: switch region weighting, enable progressive shed, and rollback canary; 5) Add two automated end-to-end tests that fail if admission_reject_rate > 2% under nominal traffic and that p99.9 shifts by >2x under synthetic overload without shed configured.
tasks: Design metric names and low-cardinality tag set
Implement histogram exporter in admission controller and tokenizer path
Build synthetic shadow runner (k8s job + runner CLI)
Create Grafana dashboard panels and alert rules
Write runbook and playbook for cross-region failover
Add CI tests and synthetic scenarios
Coordinate with Dedicated infra and Console teams for rollout
